what.text: This page follows refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina living in Denmark, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4921 refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina in Denmark, 20.0% of all refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Serbia and Kosovo is the largest host of refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina, followed by France and Denmark.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflicts in Bosnia-Herzegovina from 1992 to 1995, over Serb, Croat and Bihaca Krajina territory.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1995 to 2004, begin in the last year of those conflicts.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1993 at 2712 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 27851, at the end of 2002.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Denmark.
These are year-end totals for Denmark only, reported to UNHCR.
